concerns.text: FR-002 (filtering non-sequential datasets) and SC-001 (dataset variable coverage) lack a completed implementation task. T014 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and explicitly rejected in the analyze report, leaving the core filtering logic unimplemented.

FR-005 (multiple-comparison correction) and SC-003 (FWER control) are unimplemented. T023 and T023b are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and rejected by the analyzer, meaning the statistical correction logic is missing.
FR-007 (sensitivity analysis/MDE) and SC-005 (MDE reporting) lack a completed task. T025 is incomplete, and the required T025b (logging MDE for every dataset) is missing entirely from the task list.
Edge Case handling for LMM convergence (Spec: Edge Cases) is unimplemented. T022 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`), and the fallback logic for non-converging models is not covered by any other task.
FR-006 (Cohen's d effect sizes) and FR-009 (bootstrap resampling) lack implementation tasks. T024 and T028/T028b are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`), leaving critical statistical outputs undefined.
FR-002 filtering logic and SC-001 coverage verification are incomplete. T014 is incomplete, and T017 (standardized CSV generation) is incomplete, blocking the data pipeline required for US1.

SC-004 (computational feasibility) and SC-006 (reproducibility) are unverified. T033 (Dockerfile), T034 (runtime test), and T034b (quickstart guide) are all marked incomplete (`- [ ]`), preventing the verification of the 6-hour runtime constraint.

Constitution Principle VI (Experimental Design Documentation) requires storing transition-probability tables. T017b is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and rejected, violating the constitution's data hygiene mandate.
T008 contains a malformed YAML block comment (`<!-- SKIPPED: YAML+regex parse failed... -->`) that breaks the task description format and should be cleaned up.
